tier1.text: Each hamate is a carpal bone, one of the eight small bones that form the wrist and the base of the hand. A muscle that bends the little finger is attached to the hamate. The front side of the hamate has a bony hook, called the hook of the hamate. The name hamate means “hooked bone.”
